explanation: Falconer's distance set conjecture in the plane: compact E ⊆ ℝ² with dim_H E > 1 has a distance set of positive Lebesgue measure. The statement is faithful. It is tagged solved on the basis of an OpenAI 2026 result with a linked Lean proof, which I did not verify; the previously known threshold was 5/4 (Guth–Iosevich–Ou–Wang).
